display_long_description:
Step up to the plate with the all-new MLB App on Meta Quest. The MLB App is the #1 destination for live baseball video and audio, highlights and much more. 

Get closer to the game with immersive ballparks and live 3D data visualization. See every play come to life with pitch data, batter stats, and real-time player positions in the MLB App for Meta Quest.

- **Live MLB Games:** Watch games live and On-Demand with Interactive Play-by-Play and 3D data visualization.
- **Gameday 3D:** See the game from every angle with 3D player models and dynamic camera options.
- **Immersive Environments:** Bring the ballpark to you with 30 detailed MLB stadiums.
- **Multi Game Streaming:** Watch up to five games simultaneously from around the league.
- **MLB in 3D:** View the best clips, highlights and  key moments in Spatial Video. 
- **Deep Stat Integration:** Surfaces live metrics for analytics and better game understanding.
MLB in Shared Space: Never miss a play - pop-out video and audio lets you keep the game on while you multitask.

# Subscribers Get More
- Access the Official Site of Major League Baseball subscription to watch every out-of-market game.
- Listen to home, away and Spanish-language (where available) radio broadcasts live and on demand with MLB At Bat.
- 3D player data and universal audio support for MLB At Bat Subscribers

*MLB App is an immersive experience, not a game.

Privacy Policy: mlb.com/privacy
Terms of Use: mlb.com/tou
© 2026 MLB Advanced Media, L.P.
